initial_analysis:
This is a high-skill matchup between two elite squads. We have a tanky Decimator (12H/4S), the premier I6 ace Vader in a Defender, and a solid support piece in Gideon Hask. The enemy brings Boba Fett's consistent damage and reposition, the extremely dangerous Fenn Rau (I6 ace that hits like a truck at Range 1), and Durge who is annoyingly durable with his regen ability.

KEY MATCHUP FACTORS:
- Initiative tie at I6 between Vader and Fenn Rau means Vader moves first but shoots first - this slightly favors us defensively as Vader can arc-dodge after seeing Fenn's position
- Chiraneau at I5 moves after Boba/Durge but before them in combat - decent for arc coverage
- Enemy squad is more maneuverable overall; we have more raw HP (19H/8S vs 15H/6S)
- Fenn Rau is a glass cannon (4H/0S) - extremely deadly at R1 but fragile if caught
- Our Decimator provides consistent damage and can absorb enemy fire

CRITICAL CONCERN: Fenn Rau at Range 1 with Concordia Faceoff can delete ships. We must deny him favorable engagements or eliminate him fast.
my_squad_strengths: Vader's I6 with 3 agility Defender chassis is extremely survivable and can arc-dodge
Chiraneau's massive health pool (16 effective HP) absorbs damage and controls space
Gideon Hask's ability punishes damaged ships - excellent finisher
Vader's full throttle + evade token makes him very tanky
Good damage output across all ships
my_squad_weaknesses: Decimator has 0 agility - will take consistent damage from Boba's 3-dice attacks
Gideon Hask is fragile (3H/0S) - easy half points or kill for Fenn
Less overall maneuverability than enemy squad
If Vader gets blocked, he's vulnerable to focused fire
Enemy has better repositioning options (Boba's slave 1 title, Fenn's boost/barrel roll)
enemy_threats: Fenn Rau - At Range 1 he rolls 4+ dice with Concordia Faceoff reducing your defense. Can one-shot Gideon or cripple Vader if he catches him
Boba Fett - Consistent 3-dice from front AND rear arc, very durable at 10 effective HP, hard to shake
Durge - His pilot ability makes him frustrating to kill; don't over-commit to finishing him if it costs position
opponent_tendencies: Unknown - observing. Watch for: Does Fenn joust or flank? Does Boba fly aggressive or as a turret platform? Is Durge used as a blocker or damage dealer?
